# sigma_workbooks (Data Source)

Lists Sigma workbooks. Results preserve Sigma API order; key collections by returned IDs rather than positional indices. Pagination cursors and page sizes are not exposed; this data source retrieves every page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sigma_workbooks" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `exclude_explorations` (Boolean) Whether to exclude explorations (`excludeExplorations`). Explicit `false` is sent; null omits the parameter.
- `exclude_tags` (Boolean) Whether to exclude tags (`excludeTags`). Explicit `false` is sent; null omits the parameter.
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Archived filter (`isArchived`). Explicit `false` is sent; null omits the parameter.
- `skip_permission_check` (Boolean) Whether to skip permission checks (`skipPermissionCheck`). Explicit `false` is sent; null omits the parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identifier for this data source.
- `workbooks` (Attributes List) Workbooks in API order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workbooks))

<a id="nestedatt--workbooks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workbooks`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) Creator member ID.
- `description` (String) Workbook description.
- `id` (String) Workbook ID.
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Whether the workbook is archived.
- `latest_version` (Number) Latest workbook version.
- `name` (String) Workbook name.
- `owner_id` (String) Owner member ID.
- `path` (String) Workbook path.
- `tagged_source_url_id` (String) Source workbook URL ID for a tenant-deployed workbook. Present when Sigma returns `taggedSourceUrlId`.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Version tags on the workbook. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workbooks--tags))
- `updated_at` (String) Update timestamp.
- `updated_by` (String) Last updater member ID.
- `url` (String) Workbook URL.
- `url_id` (String) Workbook URL ID.

<a id="nestedatt--workbooks--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workbooks.tags`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Tag name.
- `source_workbook_version` (Number) Source workbook version.
- `tagged_workbook_id` (String) Tagged workbook ID.
- `version_tag_id` (String) Version tag ID.
- `workbook_tagged_at` (String) When the workbook was tagged.
